joshua.18.p1.b1.text: Then the whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there. And though the land was subdued before them,

joshua.18.p1.b2.text: there were still seven tribes of Israel who had not yet received their inheritance.

joshua.18.p1.b3.text: How long will you put off entering and possessing the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?

joshua.18.p1.b4.text: Appoint three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to survey the land … Then they will return to me

joshua.18.p2.b1.text: Go and survey the land, map it out, and return to me. Then I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD.

joshua.18.p2.b2.text: So the men departed and went throughout the land, mapping it city by city into seven portions. Then they returned with the document to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.

joshua.18.p2.b3.text: And Joshua cast lots for them in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh, where he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their divisions.

joshua.18.p3.b1.text: The first lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:

joshua.18.p3.b2.text: On the north side their border began at the Jordan, went up past the northern slope of Jericho …

joshua.18.p3.b3.text: On the east side the border was the Jordan. These were the borders around the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.

joshua.18.p3.b4.text: … Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim —fourteen cities, along with their villages. This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
